description:
Comment on a track

Adds a comment, optionally at a second of the track (kind note, fix, keep or marker). The section label is computed from timed sections only.

at_second.description: Position in the track, rounded to 0.1 s

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

name: add_comment

description: Call an API operation by id with the arguments described by describe_operation. Operations excluded from MCP are refused.
name: call_operation

description:
Cancel a generation job

Records a cancel intent; the runner cancels the provider job and settles what ran. Terminal jobs are unchanged. An agent can cancel only its own batches' jobs.
name: cancel_job

description:
Create a draft

Stores a new backlog draft from a song request. Drafts are always protocol-valid; songwriting warnings are returned, not blocking.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

request.description: Song request object (id, style or tags, lyrics, cot, seed, abc, cfg_scale)

name: create_draft

description:
Create a generation batch

Spends money: needs the confirmation_token of a fresh estimate. Reserves the cost ceiling and queues one job per take; above your auto-approve limits a human must approve (request_approval).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

rationale.description: Why; stored on the batch and the Operator Ledger

name: create_generation

description:
Create a playlist

Creates a playlist, optionally with an ordered list of track ids (at most 1000).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

name: create_playlist

description:
Create variants of a track

Spends money: needs the confirmation_token of a fresh estimate. Confirms an estimate_variant of this track; same approval rules as create_generation. Needs an Idempotency-Key.

id.description: The mother track of the estimate

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

rationale.description: Why; stored on the batch and the Operator Ledger

name: create_variant

description: Describe an API operation that is not exposed as its own tool: method, path, scope, cost, description and the input/output JSON schemas. Use with call_operation.
name: describe_operation

description:
Estimate a generation batch

Plans 1-20 items (new seeds, edits, drafts, templates, new songs) into at most 50 takes and prices them. Free. Returns the worst-case cost, warnings and the confirmation_token create_generation needs.

mode.description: How the take list is built; see the modes table

parent_track_id.description: Variants: the mother (required). from_draft: optional mother override

abc.description: A string sets the score, null removes it, absent keeps it

cfg_scale.description: A number sets it, null removes it, absent keeps it

recipe.description: compose_new: the song request, as sent

template_mode.description: from_template: the mode applied to every mother

name: estimate_generation

description:
Estimate variants of a track

Prices new-seed, same-seed edit, lyric edit or style edit takes of one mother track. Free; returns the confirmation_token create_variant needs. Reference tracks cannot be mothers.

abc.description: A string sets the score, null removes it, absent keeps it

cfg_scale.description: A number sets it, null removes it, absent keeps it

name: estimate_variant

description:
Export songs.jsonl

Exports an imported source file, a track selection or drafts as a songs.jsonl that yue2 batch accepts, with the validator result and a signed download link. Small files are also returned inline.

for_batch.description: Selection source only: make ids unique so yue2 batch accepts the file

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Omit it and the server derives a key from (caller, operation, arguments): an identical call within 10 minutes replays the first result instead of acting twice. Pass distinct keys to repeat an action on purpose; explicit keys are remembered for 24 hours.

source_path.description: Selection source: a path from list_export_sources

name: export_jsonl

description:
Get a draft

One draft with its request, lyric structure, collections, group, recipe sources, revision and lint result. Private reference metadata is returned to the operator only; agents see has_reference.
name: get_draft

description:
Get a generation job

One job: state, outcome, cost, timings, environment, artifacts and its newest events. The job id is the take id.
name: get_job

description:
Get signed media links

Signed, expiring URLs for the lossless FLAC master and the MP3 rendition of a track. For a lossy reference track flac is null and mp3 is the master itself (lossy true). Humans get 12 h links, agents 15 min.
name: get_media_links

description:
Get the songwriting duration targets

Preferred song length in seconds: at least min_duration_s, aiming for target_min_duration_s to target_max_duration_s. Lint warns when a song misses them.
name: get_songwriting_settings

description:
Get library statistics

Counts of tracks, drafts and recipes, loudness spread (listen_flac_recommended when above 2 LU), bandwidth, storage and import runs.
name: get_stats

description:
Get system information

Version, commit, auth mode, database schema version and uptime.
name: get_system_info

description:
Get a track

Full track detail: audio, recipe, lineage, score, lyric sections (timed only when a score aligns with them) and analyses.
name: get_track

description:
Get the Ears dossier of a track

Measured facts about a take: loudness, bandwidth, silence spans, clipping, token-loop metrics from the model's semantic tokens, structure and duration against the score, plus computed flags with evidence. tier is A when every applicable analyzer ran. Read blind_spots first: it lists what these numbers cannot tell you.
name: get_track_analysis

description:
Get a track's context bundle

Everything needed to critique and regenerate one take in a single size-bounded document: recipe, score, lineage, comments, perception and next actions. The _budget key reports the size.

include.description: Parts to add and protect from trimming

name: get_track_context

description:
Get the spectrogram of a track

A log-frequency spectrogram JPEG (at most 100 000 bytes) with section boundaries and lyric lines drawn in. Returns the image as MCP ImageContent; never audio. Over REST the image is base64 in image.data_base64, or pass inline=false for a signed link only. A spectrogram shows energy over time and frequency, not pitch accuracy or words; see blind_spots. Missing until Tier A analysis has run (ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE).

inline.description: Embed the image as base64 (default); false returns only a signed link

name: get_track_spectrogram

description:
Lint song requests

Checks up to 200 requests against the protocol rules and the songwriting rules (sections, line counts, repeat markers, language, estimated duration, duplicates). Read-only; nothing is stored.

batch.description: Also check ids for duplicates across items (default true)

request.description: The request object to lint, as sent

name: lint_recipe

description:
List backlog drafts

Recipe drafts (not yet rendered recipes), by default the backlog, ordered by group then request id. Filter by text, collection, group or origin (import_backlog, varianti_import, editor, agent, jsonl_upload). Each row carries its lint counts.
name: list_drafts

description:
List playlists

Playlists with their track counts and total duration; hidden ones only with include_hidden.
name: list_playlists

description:
Get the next duel to judge

The oldest unexpired duel waiting for your verdict, with signed clip links, or null. Humans and paired devices judge as the operator; agents judge as critics and only see open duels they have not judged. Blind duels stay unrevealed until you have judged them.
name: next_duel

description:
Ping the server

Liveness check that also reports the server version.
name: ping

description:
Rate a track

Sets or clears your 1-5 star rating and short verdict. Humans rate as the operator; agent ratings are kept apart as the critic.

stars.description: 1..5, or null to clear your rating

name: rate_track

description:
Search tracks

Lists library tracks with full-text search (q), status, style, duration, date, score, truncation, rating (min_stars, unrated), tag, open-comment, recipe_known and lossy filters. Discarded tracks are hidden unless status asks for them. Pages are capped in size; follow next_cursor.

lossy.description: true lists tracks whose master is an MP3; false only lossless masters

min_stars.description: Human stars at least; exclusive with unrated

q.description: Free text over title, request id, style and lyrics (prefix match)

recipe_known.description: false lists reference tracks (recipe unknown); true only tracks with a real recipe

recorded_to.description: RFC 3339 date (whole day, inclusive) or date-time

sort.description: Default recorded_desc, or relevance when q is set; stars_desc is human stars, unrated last

style.description: Repeatable style term; all must match

unrated.description: No human rating (or a cleared one); exclusive with min_stars

name: search_tracks

description:
Add or remove tags

Adds and removes free-form tags. Tags normalise to lower case; a human removal wins over agent tags.

add.description: Tags to add (normalised: lower case, single spaces)

name: set_tags

description:
Judge a duel

Records a verdict: a (slot A is better), b, tie or both_bad, with an optional note. Verdicts from agents are stored as critic opinions and never change the human ladder. Judging again with the same verdict and note returns the stored verdict (200, replayed); a different verdict is DUEL_ALREADY_JUDGED.

verdict.description: a or b: that slot is better; tie; both_bad: neither is acceptable

name: submit_duel

description:
Update a comment

Edits the body or kind, hides it, or changes its state (open, resolved; reopen). Authors and the operator may edit; agents only their own.
name: update_comment

description:
Wait for a job to change

Long-poll: returns as soon as the job's state differs from since_state (default: now) or is terminal, else after timeout_s (0-55, default 25) with timed_out true.

since_state.description: Return as soon as the state differs; default the state at call time

name: wait_for_job

description:
Show the calling principal

Returns the identity, scopes and authentication path of the caller.
name: whoami
